transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess they brought me in because of what's been happening at the warehouse. I just... I keep doing things. Like, I'll freeze with my arms up in the air right by the forklift. Or I'll start copying the backing-up beeping sounds and the hand signals the other guys make. 

I also end up moving the boxes around in these strange little patterns. I just keep doing it, even when everyone is yelling for me to stop. So, yeah, that's why I'm here.
Do you feel like you're in control when you're freezing or copying the sounds and movements?

I'm not really sure. I don't... I don't really think about whether I'm in control or not when it's happening. It just sort of happens. Like, I know I'm the one doing it, but I don't know why I can't just stop when they yell at me. So, yeah, I don't really know how to answer that.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
No, not really. I mean, I don't... I don't have thoughts looping around in my head or anything like that. It's not really about what I'm thinking. So, no, nothing repeating.
Do you ever feel the need to perform specific rituals or routines when you're not at the warehouse?

Um, no, not really. It's... it's mostly just at work. When I'm at home or just out somewhere, I don't feel like I need to do any special routines or rituals or anything like that. I just kind of sit around. So, no, nothing like that outside the warehouse.
Do you feel anxious when you're freezing or copying the sounds and movements at the warehouse?

No, I don't really feel anxious. It's not like I'm scared or nervous when it happens. It's just... I'm just doing it. I don't really feel much of anything at all when I freeze up or copy things like that. So, no, I wouldn't say I feel anxious.
Do you feel upset or bothered by these episodes of freezing or copying sounds and movements at the warehouse?

No, it doesn't really bother me. I mean... I don't get upset about it or anything. Like I was saying, I don't really feel much when it's happening, so it doesn't really bother me afterward either. It just kind of is what it is.
Do you ever hear or see things that other people don't?
Um, no. I don't think so. I just see and hear what everyone else does, really. I haven't noticed anything like... hearing voices or seeing things that aren't actually there. So, no.
Do you ever feel like you have to think about something over and over when you're not at the warehouse?

No, I don't really get stuck on thoughts like that. When I'm not at work, I just... I just go about my day, really. I haven't noticed having to think about anything over and over. So, no, that doesn't happen to me.
Do you feel like you have to do things in a specific way when you're not at the warehouse?
No, not really. I don't have any special routines or... or ways I have to do things. I just do what I need to do. I don't feel like I have to do anything in a specific way.
Do you feel distressed after these episodes of freezing or copying sounds and movements are over?

Um, I don't really have episodes like that, to be honest. I don't freeze up or... copy what other people are doing or saying. So I guess I don't feel distressed about it, since it just doesn't happen to me.
Do you ever feel like you're outside of your body watching yourself when these episodes happen at the warehouse?

No, I've never felt anything like that. I don't... I don't feel like I'm outside my body or watching myself. And like I said, I don't really have those episodes you're talking about anyway. So, no, that's not something I experience.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel compelled to think about?

No, I don't think so. I don't really have thoughts that I feel forced to think about or anything like that. My mind just kind of... does its own thing, I guess. I don't feel compelled to focus on anything specific.
Do you ever feel like you're not yourself when you're at the warehouse?
No, I don't get that feeling. I'm always just... me, whether I'm at the warehouse or somewhere else. I don't feel like I'm not myself.
Do you ever feel like you're in a trance or a daze when you're freezing or copying the sounds and movements at the warehouse?

No, I don't... I'm not in a trance or a daze. I'm fully awake when I'm at work. And like I said before, I don't really do that freezing or copying stuff anyway. I'm just... doing my job. So, no, I don't experience anything like a trance.
Do you ever feel like you're automatically doing things without being aware of them?

No, I don't really get that. I mean, I know what I'm doing. Even when work gets repetitive with moving the freight around, I'm... I'm still aware of it. I don't just do things without realizing it. I'm always paying attention to what I'm doing.
Do you have any thoughts that you try to ignore or suppress?

No, I don't... I don't really have anything like that. I don't try to push my thoughts away or ignore them. They're just... regular thoughts, I guess. I just think about what I need to do for the day, so no, I'm not trying to suppress anything.
Do you ever feel like you're not really connected to what's happening around you when you're at the warehouse?

No, I don't feel disconnected. I mean, I'm right there, moving the boxes, hearing the forklifts. I'm connected to all of it. It's loud and busy, so you kind of have to be paying attention. I don't feel like I'm somewhere else or spaced out. I'm just right there doing the work.
Do you ever feel like you're watching yourself from outside your body when you're doing the repetitive movements or freezing at the warehouse?

No, I... I don't think I've ever felt like that. I'm always just in my own body. Even if I get stuck for a minute or I'm just moving the same freight over and over, I'm still just looking out of my own eyes. I've never felt like I was watching myself from the outside or anything.
Do you ever feel like you're not really in charge of your actions when you're at the warehouse?

No, I... I'm always the one doing the work. I don't feel like someone else is controlling me or anything like that. I mean, I'm the one moving my arms and picking up the freight. Even when I get stuck for a second, it's still me. I'm always in charge of what I'm doing.
Do you ever feel like you're in a different state of mind when you're doing the repetitive movements or freezing at the warehouse?

No, not really. I mean, it's just work. I'm just focusing on the boxes and getting it done. I don't feel like I'm in a different state of mind or anything weird like that. I'm just... I'm just there, doing what I'm supposed to do. Even if I freeze up, my mind is still just right there in the warehouse.
